title: The 3-Second Trench Rule (8,000M Deep)
caption:
🚨 RULE #1 OF THE DEEP SEA: YOU HAVE 3 SECONDS TO EJECT... 🌊💔

At 8,000 meters in the Mariana Trench, the submarine hull fractured.
He had one pod. But in the cargo bay sat the only sample that could cure his sick daughter.

His final whisper before the pressure crushed the hull: 'Tell her... daddy kept his promise.'
